description:
Senior Commercial Counsel

Location: Remote / Draper, UT Hybrid

Reports to: Chris Gage, SVP Finance & Operations

Role type: Full-time Salaried Employee

About the Role

Jump is looking for its first in-house attorney–a commercially exceptional, business-minded legal generalist who can independently built our legal function.

You will lead commercial contracting and enterprise negotiations, establish scalable legal processes, and serve as a trusted advisor to our Product, Security, and go-to-market teams. This is a high-autonomy, hands-on role for someone who thrives in a fast-growing SaaS environment and wants to build a legal function from the ground up.

  • Own commercial legal: Lead SaaS MSAs, DPAs, BAAs, NDAs, strategic partnerships, and other commercial agreements from intake through execution, including direct negotiations with enterprise customer counsel.

  • Accelerate deal execution: Establish clear legal intake processes, SLAs, negotiation playbooks, templates, and approval frameworks that improve turnaround times and reduce friction for Sales.

  • Partner with Product and Security: Provide practical legal guidance on product development, AI capabilities, privacy, data protection, customer regulatory requirements, and related risks.

  • Build the legal function: Develop the infrastructure, processes, systems, and institutional knowledge needed to scale legal operations alongside the business.

  • Manage legal risk: Proactively identify and address contractual, regulatory, and operational legal risks, balancing sound legal judgment with commercial priorities.

About You

  • You're a commercially excellent attorney who can independently own complex enterprise negotiations while maintaining speed and sound business judgment

  • You understand how high-growth SaaS companies operate and know when to push back, when to compromise, and when to escalate

  • You're comfortable being Jump's first and only in-house attorney, building processes while remaining deeply hands-on

  • You're a pragmatic business partner who provides clear recommendations rather than simply identifying legal risks

  • You're naturally proactive, identifying legal needs and opportunities beyond the immediate contract queue

  • You care about financial services and are eager to develop expertise in the regulatory environment our customers navigate

  • You are direct, kind, and drama-free

What You’ve Done

  • 6+ years of legal experience, including meaningful in-house experience at a scaling B2B SaaS or technology company; exceptional candidates with different experience levels will be considered

  • Significant experience independently negotiating complex enterprise SaaS agreements, including MSAs, DPAs, and related commercial contracts

  • Working knowledge of data privacy, security, and technology-related legal matters, with the ability to partner effectively with Product and Security teams

  • Experience building or improving legal processes, playbooks, and commercial contracting workflows

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, exercise practical commercial judgment, and manage competing priorities

  • Preferred: prior big law background (tech transactions, data privacy, or financial services regulatory)

  • Preferred: experience at a well-run enterprise SaaS company where you observed a strong commercial legal function

About Jump

Jump’s mission is to empower financial advisors and their clients to thrive in the age of AI. Our AI assistant helps financial advisors automate the client meeting cycle and other workflows, turning meetings, emails, and documents into structured data, automated workflows, and compliance-ready outputs.

Jump leads its category in market share and customer satisfaction, serving leading financial services firms. We’re building the intelligence layer that powers the modern advisory firm—helping advisors save time, grow faster, and deliver better outcomes for their clients.

Jump’s team values are:

High Velocity: You are self-driven, use good judgment, and deliver high-quality work at speed.

World Class: You demonstrate excellence, study what great looks like, continuously learn, and raise the bar for the team.

Direct + Kind + No Drama: You communicate directly and openly, act with and assume best intent, and handle conflict productively.

Benefits

  • ISO Equity options

  • Unlimited Paid Vacation

  • $0 Medical insurance premium for the whole family

  • $500 Workspace Setup Stipend

  • Dental, vision, Disability, Life & Indemnity

  • HSA + Employer Match

  • FSA, & Dependent Care FSA

  • Company-paid Life Insurance

  • 401(k) + Employer Match
